scenes.title: Biggest tire on a stock Jeep Cherokee XJ?
235/75R15
scenes.body: NAXJA thread: 235/75R15 fits fine on the stock 15x7 (5.25 in backspacing).

scenes.title: 31x10.50R15
scenes.body: Expect minor rubbing at full lock; trim the front bumper ends and fender corners and roll the rear quarter seam

scenes.title: 33x12.50R15
scenes.body: Per ExtremeTerrain's fitment table, on 15x8–17x9 wheels with −12 to +6 mm offset; trimming still likely
